Alex — thanks for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned before I share the MAP:

- Need: predictable inference latency at 99th pct for customer-facing features (search & chat).
- Volume: ~12M tokens/month initial, expected to double in 6 months.
- Constraints: data residency in us-east, SOC 2 evidence required, procurement window ~6 weeks.

Draft MAP (attached: Acme_MAP_v1.1.pdf) — highlights:
1) Milestone: Proof-of-concept (PoC) deployment — target by 2027-05-10.
   - Owner: Marissa (Redwood) / Alex (Acme eng)
   - Deliverables: sample traffic run, latency dashboard, cost estimate.
2) Milestone: Security review & SOC 2 evidence exchange — target by 2027-05-17.
   - Owner: Rishi (Redwood security) / Procurement (Acme)
   - Dependencies: Redwood to provide SOC 2 summary + audit contact.
3) Milestone: Procurement & SOW sign — target close date 2027-06-01.
   - Owner: Procurement (Acme) / Marissa (Redwood)
4) Milestone: Production rollout (Dedicated) — target by 2027-06-30.

Ask / next steps:
- Alex: please confirm PoC target date (5/10) and confirm Eng owner for test plan.
- Procurement: please confirm required vendor documents and timeline.

I'll upload an editable MAP workbook after you confirm owners.

Thanks — Marissa
